2 import fs from 'node:fs';
3 import path from 'node:path';
4 import crypto from 'node:crypto';
5 import { HaltError } from './trio-core/contract-core.mjs';
6 
7 const DEV_SECRET = process.env.DEV_APPROVE_SECRET || 'local-dev-secret-only-for-tests';
8 
9 /**
10  * Issues a real signed approval token for --dev-approve.
11  */
12 export function issueDevToken(runDir, developerIdentity) {
13   const payload = {
14     runDir: path.resolve(runDir),
15     identity: developerIdentity,
16     exp: Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000 // time-boxed
17   };
18   const str = JSON.stringify(payload);
19   const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', DEV_SECRET).update(str).digest('hex');
20   return Buffer.from(str).toString('base64') + '.' + sig;
21 }
22 
23 /**
24  * Validates a signed approval token.
25  */
26 export function validateDevToken(token, runDir) {
27   if (!token) return false;
28   const parts = token.split('.');
29   if (parts.length !== 2) return false;
30   const [b64, sig] = parts;
31   
32   const str = Buffer.from(b64, 'base64').toString('utf8');
33   const expectedSig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', DEV_SECRET).update(str).digest('hex');
34   if (sig !== expectedSig) return false;
35   
36   let payload;
37   try {
38     payload = JSON.parse(str);
39   } catch (e) {
40     return false;
41   }
42   
43   if (payload.runDir !== path.resolve(runDir)) return false;
44   if (Date.now() > payload.exp) return false;
45   
46   return payload.identity;
47 }

49 /**
50  * Approval-provider interface with pluggable backends.
51  */
52 export class ApprovalProvider {
53   constructor({ token, policyGrant, ttyAllowed = true, runDir, replayFixture }) {
54     this.token = token;
55     this.policyGrant = policyGrant; // explicit per-host 'no-human-channel' policy grant
56     this.ttyAllowed = ttyAllowed;
57     this.runDir = runDir;
58     this.replayFixture = replayFixture;
59   }
60 
61   /**
62    * Evaluates the provider and returns the identity if authorized.
63    * Throws HaltError if not authorized.
64    */
65   authorize() {
66     // 0. Replay approval fixture
67     if (this.replayFixture) {
68       if (this.replayFixture.provenance === 'replay') {
69         return `ReplayFixture:${this.replayFixture.id || 'bound'}`;
70       }
71       throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Invalid fixture provenance, expected replay');
72     }
73 
74     // 1. Signed approval token (issued out-of-band, checked at the gate)
75     if (this.token) {
76       const identity = validateDevToken(this.token, this.runDir);
77       if (identity) {
78         return `Token:${identity}`;
79       } else {
80         throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Invalid or expired signed approval token');
81       }
82     }
83 
84     // 2. Explicit per-host 'no-human-channel' policy grant
85     if (this.policyGrant) {
86       return `PolicyGrant:${this.policyGrant.identity || 'host'}`;
87     }
88 
89     // 3. Interactive TTY
90     if (this.ttyAllowed && (process.stdout.isTTY || process.env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT)) {
91       return 'TTY';
92     }
93 
94     // Absence of a valid artifact/grant HALTs only that run
95     throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: No valid approval provider grant (no human channel, no token)');
96   }
97 
98   /**
99    * Validates that the current run hashes match the replay fixture hashes.
100    */
101   validateReplayBinding(triageHash, planHash) {
102     if (!this.replayFixture) return;
103     if (this.replayFixture.triageHash !== triageHash || this.replayFixture.planHash !== planHash) {
104       throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Replay fixture hashes do not match current run');
105     }
106   }
107 }

110 function invokedDirectly() {
111   const entry = process.argv[1];
112   if (!entry) return false;
113   try { return path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) === path.resolve(entry); } catch { return false; }
114 }

118   const runDir = argv.find((a) => !a.startsWith('--'));
119   if (!runDir) {
